Chrome 141 ClientHello, fresh vs resumed, captured against a Go crypto/tls
1.3 server that issues session tickets. The rig tees the first TLS record of
each TCP connection; connection 1 is fresh, connection 3 carries the ticket.

This is the reference the PSK half of resumption is pinned against: it is what
says pre_shared_key goes last, after even the trailing GREASE, and that the
extension count moves by exactly one.

=== connection 1 — ClientHello 1784 bytes ===
  psk_key_exchange_modes: 0101
  19 extensions, in order:
    0x8a8a
    0xca34
    0x0017 extended_master_secret
    0x002b supported_versions
    0xff01 renegotiation_info
    0x000d signature_algorithms
    0x0033 key_share
    0xfe0d encrypted_client_hello
    0x002d psk_key_exchange_modes
    0x0023 session_ticket
    0x000b ec_point_formats
    0x44cd application_settings
    0x000a supported_groups
    0x0010 alpn
    0x0012 signed_certificate_timestamp
    0x001b compress_certificate
    0x0005 status_request
    0x0000 server_name
    0xbaba
